Futa-focused RPG with a huge amount of giant futa femdom scenarios using koikatsu renders. 
Contains linear battle encounters with comically over-the-top battle choreographies. 
Uses AI-generated music.

A thief from another world leaves a valuable artifact in your possession, leading you to be captured and imprisoned in a tower guarded by giant futa girls, where you are relentlessly hunted by the floor guardians to retrieve the artifact.

Explore a giant prison tower filled with giant futa girls. Battle giant women by using the appropriate elemental attack. At various enemy health increments animated sequences play where your character is dominated during battle. 
(Game balance falls apart after learning a “Full Shield” ability, making the game more of a scene viewer game after the first few hours)
